newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks march higher to unofficial record.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks march higher to unofficial record.

text.p: Mexican stocks chalked up their fifth record close of the month on Wednesday.
Traders and analysts said share prices advanced steadily as investors bought heavily on greater stability in the foreign exchange and money markets.
Preliminary closing prices situated the blue chip IPC index up 53.61 points on the day, or 1.29 percent, at 4,196.53.
